name: turnkeeper-sdk-monorepo
description: Public Turnkeeper SDK, CLI, MCP server, agent-builder skill, and examples.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @turnkeeper/sdk && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release-tools && npm run package:check --workspaces --if-present && npm run smoke:packages && node scripts/validate-skill.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release-tools
